Q0482

Wang Guowei

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Wang Guowei / Q0482

English

In the realm with a self, one views things through the self, so things take on one’s coloring. In the realm without a self, one views things through things, and no longer knows which is self and which is thing.
Thinker Wang Guowei
School National Learning
Source Remarks on Lyrics in the Human World
Theme Philosophy
Another quotation More from this thinker

Source context

This English passage is associated with Remarks on Lyrics in the Human World, within the tradition of National Learning. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Wang Guowei's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
